claim: Functional clustering (largest I/O-behavior cluster mass over 100 sampled programs executed on self-generated tests) serves as a confidence estimate; thresholding it cuts LiveCodeBench returned-answer error from about 65% to 2% and to 0% while answering 15.6% of tasks.
stance_target: L1/L3: sampling-based execution-clustered confidence with abstention
scope_conditions: GPT-4o and Claude-3-Haiku (plus three GPT-4.1 variants in Table 1); HumanEval, LiveCodeBench
quoted_support: At tau_2% the verifier returns 36.8% of tasks with a 2% residual error, while tau_0% answers 15.6% of tasks with zero observed errors.
numbers: GPT-4o expected accuracy 36.9% with 4.1% error rate

breadth.confidence_families: sampling + execution clustering (dominant-cluster mass, Sec 3); related work discusses P(True), token likelihood (Sec 2)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: GPT-4o, Claude-3-Haiku, three GPT-4.1 variants (Sec 4, Table 1); sizes undisclosed
breadth.reasoning_models: CoT-plus-code prompting (Sec 4); no dedicated reasoning models
breadth.elicitation_formats: CoT plus code prompts, 50 samples (Appendix B)
breadth.label_independence: signal built from self-generated tests by GPT-4o; correctness against benchmark tests
breadth.contamination_split: not present (searched: release date, contamination, LiveCodeBench date window)
breadth.calibration_metrics: coverage vs residual error threshold curves; no ECE/Brier/AUROC found
breadth.causal_intervention: not present (searched: steering, intervention; spec-rewrite audit of 4 tasks only (Sec 4.1))

claim: Confidence is evaluated only as coverage-vs-error threshold curves; no ECE, no verbalized or hidden-state confidence, and tests are generated by GPT-4o alone, so label and signal share a test source (self-generated tests as proxy).
stance_target: L1 independence of labels; L3 no routing
quoted_support: The approach rests on two core assumptions: each task admits a single functionally correct equivalence class, and behavioral agreement on a finite, auto-generated test set is a faithful proxy for universal correctness.
